saw_lines: Sunglasses get bought on a look, then replaced each season when the frame feels dated, so buyers decide from one photo.
So the sale is won in the first frame, where the look lands or gets scrolled past unread.
Your 7 of 12 copy ads open on one sustainable line, so one opener carries the account. Name two new angles from your oba and tana styles, then run each against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 7 of 12 copy ads open on one sustainable collections line, so a buyer looking for frames reads a cause first and may keep scrolling. Name two new angles from your oba and tana styles, then run each against the opener.
One exact copy runs in 6 of 12 ads, so a buyer who sees two of them reads the same words twice. Keep the body copy, but rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each of the six ads.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has nothing to weigh against the price before clicking. Collect one real figure, like a review count or pairs shipped, and lead with it in the next batch.

18 of your 30 ads are catalog feed cards with no story, so the feed shows frames without a reason to stop. Add three story ads with a real customer moment each, then test them next to your oldest ads.
